title: Reach Up: G and H
description: Introduce G and H from the home row. Left index reaches to G, right index to H.

exercises.text: gggg hhhh gggg hhhh
fgfg jhjh fgfg jhjh
ghgh ghgh hghg hghg
fg hj fg hj ggg hhh fghj
had had had glad glad flag flag

reviewMaterial: Index fingers stretch inward to G and H, then return to F and J.

title: Upper Row: R and U
description: Reach up to R and U. Left index on R, right index on U.

exercises.text: rrrr uuuu rrrr uuuu
frfr juju frfr juju
ruru ruru urur urur
fr ju fr ju rrr uuu frju
fur fur fur jar jar rush rush

reviewMaterial: Keep wrists steady. Only the index fingers move up to R and U.

title: Upper Row: E and I
description: Add E and I. Left middle finger reaches to E, right middle to I.

exercises.text: eeee iiii eeee iiii
dede kiki dede kiki
eiei eiei ieie ieie
de ki de ki eee iii deki
see see see like like field field

reviewMaterial: Middle fingers go up to E and I and return to D and K.

title: Upper Row: W and O
description: Introduce W and O. Left ring finger on W, right ring on O.

exercises.text: wwww oooo wwww oooo
swsw lolo swsw lolo
wowo wowo owow owow
sw lo sw lo www ooo swlo
wow wow wow low low slow slow

reviewMaterial: Ring fingers reach up. Keep other fingers resting on home keys.

title: Upper Row: Q and P
description: Add Q and P. Left pinky on Q, right pinky on P.

exercises.text: qqqq pppp qqqq pppp
aqaq ;p;p aqaq ;p;p
qpqp qpqp pqpq pqpq
aq ;p aq ;p qqq ppp aq;p
quip quip quip app app quip

reviewMaterial: Pinkies stretch up to Q and P. Return immediately to A and ;.

title: Upper Row: T and Y
description: Complete the top letter row with T and Y.

exercises.text: tttt yyyy tttt yyyy
ftft jyjy ftft jyjy
tyty tyty ytyt ytyt
ft jy ft jy ttt yyy ftjy
they they they yet yet try try

reviewMaterial: Index fingers handle T and Y as well as G and H.

title: Left Hand Upper Keys
description: Practice all left-hand upper keys: Q W E R T.

exercises.text: qwer qwer qwer asdf asdf
qwer ttre qwer ttre
qa ws ed rf tg qa ws ed rf tg
water water great great trade trade
we are; we are; a great trade;

reviewMaterial: Left hand covers QWERTY left side. Always return to home row.

title: Right Hand Upper Keys
description: Practice all right-hand upper keys: Y U I O P.

exercises.text: yuiop yuiop yuiop hjkl; hjkl;
yuiop poiuy yuiop poiuy
yh uj ik ol p; yh uj ik ol p;
you you you oil oil pull pull
you look; you look; pull up;

reviewMaterial: Right hand covers YUIOP. Index stays near J and H.

title: Combining Upper and Home
description: Mix upper-row letters with home-row keys.

exercises.text: the the the you you you are are are
this this that that with with
we are; they are; you are;
the key; the key; a good idea;
she said; he said; they said yes;

reviewMaterial: Practice common words. Keep eyes on the text, not the keys.

title: Common Letter Pairs
description: Drill frequent letter pairs from the keys learned so far.

exercises.text: th th th he he he er er er an an an
re re re on on on at at at en en en
the the the and and and for for for
there there here here where where
the other; the other; rather than;

reviewMaterial: Bigrams like TH, HE, ER form the foundation of English typing speed.

title: Words with G H R U
description: Build vocabulary using recently introduced letters.

exercises.text: hard hard hard girl girl girl rush rush
half half half full full full glass glass
guard guard harsh harsh laugh laugh
a hard task; a full glass; rush ahead;
she has a hard task; he has a full day;

reviewMaterial: Use natural word patterns. Pause briefly between words.

title: Words with E I W O
description: Practice words featuring E, I, W, and O.

exercises.text: wide wide wide side side side like like
word word word will will will look look
field field yellow yellow low low
we will; we will; look wide; side door;
we will look at the wide field;

reviewMaterial: Middle and ring fingers should move independently.

title: Words with Q P T Y
description: Practice words that use Q, P, T, and Y.

exercises.text: type type type quit quit quit pay pay
pretty pretty party party quality quality
apply apply happy happy typist typist
type fast; quit late; pay early;
a pretty party; high quality type;

reviewMaterial: Q and P are edge keys. Stretch pinkies carefully.

title: Mixed Upper Row Drill
description: Full upper-row fluency with home-row support.

exercises.text: qwerty uiop qwerty uiop
the power; the power; type power;
we type; you type; they type words;
your power; our power; the quiet type;
we type words with power and quiet care;

reviewMaterial: Smooth transitions between upper and home rows build real speed.

title: Basic Letters Review
description: Review all letters introduced so far before adding bottom-row keys.

exercises.text: the quick; the quick; a quiet power;
we are here; you are there; they are ready;
type these words; type those words;
she said the power is quiet and steady;
we type with skill; you type with care;

reviewMaterial: You now know the top two letter rows. Keep fingers curved and relaxed.
